meta.titulo: Porsche 992 second-hand and used — Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Offer for Porsche 911 type 992, with revision of 111 points. Twelve months coverage. Kilometers certified on the invoice.

parrafos: The Porsche 992 is the latest model in the 911 series produced by Porsche AG. It was released in 2019 and is currently being manufactured. The 992 is the successor to the Porsche 991 and is considered the most advanced and technological model of the 911 series to date.

The 992 is noticeably different from previous models in the 911 series due to its body modern design and his focus on technology. The interior has also been improved with higher quality materials and more technology, including the addition of a large touch screen on the instrument panel.

We subject all vehicles to an extensive review, verifying each unit with 111 inspection elements. We have 2 engineers on our team who, together with 40 years of experience working exclusively with vehicles Porsche in sales, servicing and preparation for daily use and competition makes us leaders in the sector.

secciones.titulo: Porsche 911 vehicles certified by Valentín Motors
parrafos: The Valentín Motors approved warranty provides twelve months of coverage / a mileage limit of 10.000 kms for the engine and gearbox throughout Spain.
We have operated this warranty since 2004 and all clients prefer it to warranty options backed by 'third party' insurance.
Valentín Motors prepares cars for sale at the highest level, without sparing efforts.

The Porsche vehicles that we sell end up being used in all types of scenarios: some of them enter collections for sporadic use, others are driven sportily. We make sure that all cars are prepared for any usage scenario.
We certify that the mileage is real and we record it on the sales invoice.
